note: All seam fixtures generated with double-run determinism checks. End-to-end fixtures are ARI-bounded, not bitwise: the node embedding stage is stochastic even in the reference.
upstream_findings: parallel_boruvka(reproducible=True) is not order-stable under tied edge weights, and with ties present repeated runs can return different equal-weight MSTs (observed: dupes, nested). Fixtures store a canonical form; ports should tie-break by (weight, u, v).

Layer choice is not uniformly solvable in the reference: on nested structure argmax-persistence can prefer a near-degenerate coarse layer (seed 42: k=2, ARI 0.16 vs base 0.98), while on imbalanced topics the base layer over-fragments (0.61-0.83) and the persistence pick is right (0.92-0.96). End-to-end fixtures score max-over-layers; an API should expose all layers.
